consent.heading: Screen capture
consent.captured: The agent captures only the Diablo II: Resurrected game window, and only while the game runs and you have allowed it. It never captures the desktop or another window.
consent.sent: The agent sends the characters on the character selection screen (name, class, level, mode, ladder, era and unlocked difficulties) and the screen the game shows.
consent.neverLeaves: The captured images never leave this PC. They are kept in memory only.
consent.allowed: Capture is allowed on this PC.
consent.withdrawn: Capture is off. The agent reads nothing.
consent.notSaved: Could not save your choice. Try again.
